title: Bear's Elytra Replacer
description: Replaces Your Broken Elytra With A Fresh New One, Completely Automatic!
body:
Replaces Your Broken Elytra With A Fresh New One, Completely Automatic!

**Commands:**
/ElytraReplacer Toggle
Toggles the elytra replacing, on default on.

/ElytraReplacer Support
Send link to the [Discord](https://discord.gg/b7sfwQgVS9) where you can get support.

/ElytraReplacer Credits 
Credits the mod creator / me :D
